papers.title: Beyond Simply Environment Scaling: Designing Effective Environment Distributions for Multimodal Agent Learning
papers.desc: Recent works train agents by constructing large-scale multimodal environment pools.

papers.title: SFT Conflicts, RL Coexists: A Theoretical and Empirical Analysis of Multi-Task Learning for LLMs
papers.desc: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) exhibit fundamentally different behaviors in enhancing multi-task reasoning for large language models (LLMs).

papers.title: When Activation Oracles Learn Not to Read: Concept-Specific Blind Spots in Fine-Tuned Oracles
papers.desc: Activation Oracles (AOs) are language models trained to answer natural-language questions about another model's internal activations.

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Evolving Rubrics as Rewards for Audio Reasoning
papers.desc: Audio reasoning is essential for machine understanding of the acoustic world.

papers.title: Efficient Knowledge Distillation for LLMs: Offline Top-K Logits and a Fused Chunked KL Loss
papers.desc: Small language models are often the only option for deployment under tight latency, cost, and on-premises constraints, but they are rarely trained from scratch: a compressed model is usually recovered through knowledge distillation (KD).

papers.title: Relevant but Incomplete: Referential Dangling as a Paradigm-Level Failure Mode in Hard Prompt Compression
papers.desc: Hard prompt compression reduces long-context inference cost by independently scoring tokens, sentences, or chunks and retaining the highest-scoring units under a budget.

papers.title: Small Foundation Models of Human Cognition and Behaviour
papers.desc: Large language models fine-tuned on human behavioural data have emerged as general-purpose cognitive proxies, but the scale this requires, and whether these models process task structure or exploit statistical shortcuts, remain open questions.

papers.title: Do AI Personas Grow? Analyzing and Benchmarking Personality Evolution in LLM Agents After Life Events
papers.desc: Personality-conditioned LLM agents (PC-Agents) are increasingly used in emotional support, social simulation, and role-playing, motivating the development of lifelong agents that remain coherent over extended interactions.

papers.title: Zero Gap Is Not Restoration: Stratified Per-Question Probability Evaluation and Step-wise Mitigation of Benchmark Contamination
papers.desc: Test data from public benchmarks inevitably leaks into pretraining corpora, inflating evaluation scores once memorized.

papers.title: Adversarial Attacks for Good: A Survey of Proactive Protection across the Visual Content Lifecycle
papers.desc: Once visual content enters an AI pipeline, its owner often retains little technical control over how it is used.

papers.title: FATE: Frame-Level Audio-Visual Temporal Embedding
papers.desc: When a dog opens its mouth and barks, humans naturally recognize what the sound is and when it occurs.

papers.title: Can MLLMs Decode the Creative Leap? Introducing C4 for Cross-Concept Understanding
papers.desc: Creative capabilities of MLLMs matter in design, communication, education, and human--AI collaboration, yet remain difficult to evaluate because explicit targets and reward signals are scarce compared with accuracy-oriented tasks.

papers.title: OneEmo: A Unified Multimodal Reasoning Model for Emotion Perception, Understanding, and Interaction
papers.desc: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in emotional intelligence.

papers.title: Capek 0.5: An Execution-Centric Vision-Language Model for Embodied Intelligence
papers.desc: Vision-language models are increasingly serving as the reasoning core of embodied agents.

papers.title: Towards Interpretable Foundation Models for Retinal Fundus Images
papers.desc: Foundation models are used to extract transferable representations from large amounts of unlabeled data, typically via self-supervised learning (SSL).
